name: 11635-sharedprefixdecode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine. No router, no external cache tier, no offload.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, bounded at 1024 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn: one shared prefix of 2048 tokens (prefix_count 1, so every request gets the same one) plus 256 unique prompt tokens in, 512 tokens out, greedy. `request_format: plain`, so the prompt is the shared prefix followed by the request's own text with no chat wrapper. Mins equal maxes, so every request gets exactly those counts.
purpose: An 8B handbook question-answering service for 64 concurrent staff sharing one long reference document, on a single GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line for this item. Nothing here is tuned.
# max-num-seqs, max-num-batched-tokens and enable-prefix-caching are the engine's own resolved
# defaults at this commit, written out because all three resolve differently depending on
# VLLM_USE_V1 -- which is an environment variable here, not a CLI flag. See env.yaml.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
dtype: bfloat16
tensor-parallel-size: 1
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
block-size: 16
enable-prefix-caching: true
disable-log-requests: true
